name: InsightStack - CardOpened
description: The key action on this surface, driven: clicking an insight opens it IN PLACE - its detail, the questions it came out of, the ways forward and the go-deeper box unfold inside the column while the cards below stay collapsed and keep their positions. A resting screenshot of the stack cannot show that the column is a set of things you open rather than a list you read.

interactions.text: The whiteboard is a symptom of an ownership gap
